summary_md: **Gongbo ([@Gary46518347](https://x.com/Gary46518347/status/2116160919352795525))** introduces **ClaimNov** ([arXiv 2610.36511](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36511)), which checks AI-scientist novelty claim by claim, catching 97% of disguised papers at 1.5% false alarms and keeping 91 of 100 novel proposals; the team is also building OpenAI4S, a PKU science agent logging every step ([emmatliu/claimnov](https://github.com/emmatliu/claimnov), [PKU-YuanGroup/OpenAI4S](http://github.com/PKU-YuanGroup/OpenAI4S)).
